review.notes: Research candidate only: causative en- plus the free adjective base sure in its certain-result reading. Modern prefix and whole-word evidence support a meaningful teaching boundary, beyond historical origin alone. The exact en + sure spelling requires no deletion or alternation. The provisional prefix and base identities are not merged with existing pending en-, empathy, suffix -en or assure families. Independent linguistic and canonical-family review remains required. This analysis covers the canonical surface ensure; accepted lexical variant insure stays accepted without an invented negative-in or alternate-surface graph.

Research candidate only: retain inform as an intact modern teaching base for giving information. Its historical shaping formation does not establish a transparent negative-in plus document-form analysis. Atomic describes the chosen teaching unit, not a claim that the word lacks historical or derivative morphology. The provisional identity remains separate from the unreviewed clinical morph.inform stem. A future reviewed inform + -ed relationship may be legitimate, but no shared runtime identity, clinical phrase graph, informed adjective or specialist approval is granted here.

Research candidate only for the independently accepted gathering sense: retain collect as an intact modern teaching base. The sources describe historical col-/com- and Latin legere/collect- development; they do not by themselves establish a transparent modern col + lect game lesson. This is not a universal claim of monomorphemicity. The sense-specific provisional identity avoids silently equating gathering with the pending pickup uses of morph.collect. The old morph.collect graph, related collection/pickup/payment entries and their review gates remain exact. Same lexical ID preserves historical skill records, whose old pickup evidence cannot be certified as gathering mastery by this morphology proposal.
